summary: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
entries.definitive_edition: Original Atari 2600 cartridge, with Stella as preservation fallback

emulation.notes: Use accurate Atari 2600 settings and document controller/difficulty switch state.

primary.why: The 1982 Atari 2600 game is the historical artifact; it has no current official modern remaster route that supersedes original hardware or accurate Atari 2600 emulation. Preservation should document controller, difficulty switches, manual knowledge, and whether playing on hardware or Stella.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Atari 2600 cartridge on original hardware if possible, or Stella with accurate settings. Record hardware/emulator, region, controller, difficulty switch positions, manual use, and whether landfill/history context was documented separately.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if original hardware capture is unavailable.
secondary.why: The game is an Atari 2600 artifact and benefits from exact emulator/hardware documentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Accurate emulation route for preservation capture.
all_releases.reason: secondary: use if original hardware capture is unavailable.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original hardware is the historical ceiling; Stella is the practical preservation route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record difficulty switches and manual use; no modern official remaster route is sourced here.
